```{r BRT Conservative Pipeline}

  # Set the seed for reproducibility
    set.seed(1999)

	## Input directory: per-iteration .rds files with combined presence + PA data
	  INPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_BRTs_New/PA_Iterations"

	## Output directory for tuned BRT results
	  OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_BRTs_New/Tuned_BRT_Results"

	## Create output subdirectories
  	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models"),              showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence"),   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

	## Conservative BRT parameters for the 50–100 occurrence tier
	## tc=1: additive only, no interaction terms (Elith et al. 2008)
	## bag.fraction=0.5: more stochasticity per tree for regularization
	## n.folds=5: stable fold sizes (~13 presences per test fold)
	## step.size=25: finer evaluation of optimal tree number
  	BRT_PARAMS <- list(
  		tree.complexity = 1,
  		learning.rate   = 0.001,
  		bag.fraction    = 0.5,
  		n.folds         = 5,
  		family          = "bernoulli",
  		step.size       = 25,
  		max.trees       = 50000
  	)

	## The four "Tuned BRT" species (50–100 occurrences)
  	TUNED_SPECIES <- c(
  		"Aedes vexans",
  		"Culex theileri",
  		"Haemaphysalis inermis",
  		"Hyalomma marginatum"
  	)

	## Species-to-taxon mapping (determines covariate set)
  	MOSQUITO_SPECIES <- c("Aedes vexans", "Culex theileri")
  	TICK_SPECIES     <- c("Haemaphysalis inermis", "Hyalomma marginatum")

	## Categorical covariate
	  CATEGORICAL_VAR <- "WorldCover"

	## Mosquito covariates: climate + terrain + NDVI + wind (no soil)
  	MOSQUITO_VARS <- c(
  		"hurs", "pr", "sfcWind", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",
  		"NDVI", "Elevation", "Slope", CATEGORICAL_VAR
  	)

	## Tick covariates: climate + terrain + NDVI + soil (no wind)
  	TICK_VARS <- c(
  		"hurs", "pr", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",
  		"NDVI", "Elevation", "Slope",
  		"BulkDensity", "CoarseFragments", "Nitrogen",
  		"SoilpH", "SandContent", "SiltContent", "SoilOrganicCarbon",
  		CATEGORICAL_VAR
  	)


	#' Retrieve appropriate covariate names for a given species
  	get_predictor_vars <- function(species_name) {
  		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return(MOSQUITO_VARS)
  		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return(TICK_VARS)
  		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
  	}


	#' Determine vector type label for a species
  	get_vector_type <- function(species_name) {
  		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return("mosquito")
  		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return("tick")
  		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
  	}


	#' Prepare a data frame for BRT modeling
	#' Selects response + predictors, drops NAs, converts WorldCover to factor
  	prepare_brt_data <- function(df, predictor_vars) {
  
  		model_df <- df |>
  			dplyr::select(presence, all_of(predictor_vars)) |>
  			drop_na()
  
  		## Ensure WorldCover is treated as categorical
  		if (CATEGORICAL_VAR %in% names(model_df)) {
  			model_df <- model_df |>
  				mutate(!!CATEGORICAL_VAR := as.factor(.data[[CATEGORICAL_VAR]]))
  		}
  
  		return(model_df)
  	}


	#' Fit a single BRT model via dismo::gbm.step()
	#' Returns NULL on failure rather than stopping the pipeline
  	fit_single_brt <- function(model_data, predictor_vars, params) {
  
  		## Column indices required by gbm.step
  		  response_col  <- which(names(model_data) == "presence")
  		  predictor_cols <- which(names(model_data) %in% predictor_vars)
  
  		## Fit with suppressed convergence warnings (expected for binary data)
    		model <- tryCatch({
    			suppressWarnings({
    				gbm.step(
    					data            = as.data.frame(model_data),
    					gbm.x           = predictor_cols,
    					gbm.y           = response_col,
    					family           = params$family,
    					tree.complexity  = params$tree.complexity,
    					learning.rate    = params$learning.rate,
    					bag.fraction     = params$bag.fraction,
    					n.folds          = params$n.folds,
    					step.size        = params$step.size,
    					max.trees        = params$max.trees,
    					plot.main        = FALSE,
    					plot.folds       = FALSE,
    					silent           = TRUE
    				)
    			})
    		}, error = function(e) {
    			warning("BRT fitting failed: ", e$message)
    			return(NULL)
    		})
    
    		return(model)
    	}


	#' Extract performance statistics from a fitted gbm.step model
  	extract_model_stats <- function(model) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) {
  			return(tibble(
  				n_trees            = NA_integer_,
  				cv_deviance_mean   = NA_real_,
  				cv_deviance_se     = NA_real_,
  				training_auc       = NA_real_,
  				cv_auc             = NA_real_,
  				cv_correlation     = NA_real_,
  				deviance_explained = NA_real_
  			))
  		}

		## Optimal number of trees from CV
		  n_trees <- model$gbm.call$best.trees

		## CV deviance at optimal tree number
		  cv_deviance_mean <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean
		  cv_deviance_se   <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.se

		## AUC: training and cross-validated
		  training_auc <- model$self.statistics$discrimination
		  cv_auc       <- model$cv.statistics$discrimination.mean

		## CV correlation (Pearson between observed and predicted in held-out folds)
		  cv_correlation <- model$cv.statistics$correlation.mean

		## Deviance explained: (null - residual) / null × 100
		  deviance_explained <- (1 - (model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean /
		                            model$self.statistics$mean.null)) * 100

  		tibble(
  			n_trees            = n_trees,
  			cv_deviance_mean   = cv_deviance_mean,
  			cv_deviance_se     = cv_deviance_se,
  			training_auc       = training_auc,
  			cv_auc             = cv_auc,
  			cv_correlation     = cv_correlation,
  			deviance_explained = deviance_explained
  		)
  	}


	#' Extract variable importance from a fitted gbm.step model
  	extract_var_importance <- function(model) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## gbm.step stores relative influence in the summary
  		importance <- summary(model, plotit = FALSE) |>
  			as_tibble() |>
  			rename(variable = var, rel_influence = rel.inf)
  
  		return(importance)
  	}


	#' Extract partial dependence data for all predictors from a gbm.step model
	#' Returns a tibble with variable, x-value, and predicted y-value columns
  	extract_partial_dependence <- function(model, predictor_vars) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## Iterate across all predictors and extract PDP values
    		pdp_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
    			seq_along(predictor_vars),
    			function(var_idx) {
  
  				## gbm::plot.gbm returns the PDP data invisibly
    				pdp <- tryCatch({
    					plot.gbm(model, i.var = var_idx, return.grid = TRUE)
    				}, error = function(e) {
    					return(NULL)
    				})
    
    				if (is.null(pdp)) return(NULL)
    
    				tibble(
    					variable = predictor_vars[var_idx],
    					x        = as.numeric(pdp[[1]]),
    					y        = pdp$y
    				)
    			}
    		)
  
  		return(pdp_data)
  	}


  # LOAD AND DISAGGREGATE ITERATION DATA BY SPECIES

  	## List all iteration files
    	iteration_files <- list.files(
    		INPUT_DIR,
    		pattern    = "^brt_data_iteration_\\d{3}\\.rds$",
    		full.names = TRUE
    	) |>
    		sort()

  	## Verify we have all 100
    	if (length(iteration_files) != 100) {
    		warning("Expected 100 iteration files, found ", length(iteration_files))
    	}

	  sample_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[1])

  	## Confirm our four target species are present
    	available_species <- unique(sample_data$species)
    	missing_species   <- setdiff(TUNED_SPECIES, available_species)

    	if (length(missing_species) > 0) {
    		stop("Missing species in iteration data: ", paste(missing_species, collapse = ", "))
    	}
    	
	purrr::walk(TUNED_SPECIES, ~ cat("  •", .x, "\n"))

  	## Clean up sample data
    	rm(sample_data)
    	gc()


  # RUN THE MODELS! Code structured w/ assistance from claude.ai;
    	# verified and double-checked prior to and following the
    	# completed run.
    	
  	purrr::walk(
  		TUNED_SPECIES,
  		function(sp) {
  
  			cat("\n───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  			cat("SPECIES:", sp, "\n")
  			cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  			## Determine covariate set based on taxon
  			predictor_vars <- get_predictor_vars(sp)
  			vector_type    <- get_vector_type(sp)
  
  			cat("  Vector type:", vector_type, "\n")
  			cat("  Predictors: ", length(predictor_vars), "\n")
  
  			## Containers to accumulate results across iterations
  			all_models     <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  			all_stats      <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  			all_varimp     <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  			all_pdp        <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  
  			## Track iteration-level progress
  			n_failed <- 0L
  
  			purrr::walk(
  				seq_along(iteration_files),
  				function(i) {
  
  					if (i %% 10 == 1 || i == length(iteration_files)) {
  						cat(sprintf("  Iteration %3d / %d ...\n", i, length(iteration_files)))
  					}
  
  					## Load this iteration and filter to target species
  					iter_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[i]) |>
  						dplyr::filter(species == sp)
  
  					## Prepare for modeling
  					model_data <- prepare_brt_data(iter_data, predictor_vars)
  
  					## Report sample size on first iteration
  					if (i == 1) {
  						n_pres <- sum(model_data$presence == 1)
  						n_abs  <- sum(model_data$presence == 0)
  						cat(sprintf("  Sample size: %d presences, %d pseudo-absences\n", n_pres, n_abs))
  					}
  
  					## Fit BRT
  					model <- fit_single_brt(model_data, predictor_vars, BRT_PARAMS)
  
  					## Track failures
  					if (is.null(model)) {
  						n_failed <<- n_failed + 1L
  					}
  
  					## Store model object
  					all_models[[i]] <<- model
  
  					## Extract statistics
  					all_stats[[i]] <<- extract_model_stats(model) |>
  						mutate(iteration = i)
  
  					## Extract variable importance
  					varimp <- extract_var_importance(model)
  					if (!is.null(varimp)) {
  						all_varimp[[i]] <<- varimp |>
  							mutate(iteration = i)
  					}
  
  					## Extract partial dependence
  					pdp <- extract_partial_dependence(model, predictor_vars)
  					if (!is.null(pdp)) {
  						all_pdp[[i]] <<- pdp |>
  							mutate(iteration = i)
  					}
  
  					## Free memory from loaded iteration data
  					rm(iter_data, model_data, model)
  
  				}
  			) ## End iteration loop
  
  			## Report completion for this species
  			cat(sprintf("\n  Completed: %d models fit, %d failures\n",
  			            length(iteration_files) - n_failed, n_failed))
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE AND SAVE STATISTICS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Performance statistics across all iterations
  			species_stats <- bind_rows(all_stats) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  			## Summary statistics (means + SDs across iterations)
  			species_summary <- species_stats |>
  				dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_trees)) |>
  				summarise(
  					species            = first(species),
  					vector_type        = first(vector_type),
  					n_models           = n(),
  					n_failed           = n_failed,
  					n_trees_mean       = mean(n_trees),
  					n_trees_sd         = sd(n_trees),
  					n_trees_min        = min(n_trees),
  					n_trees_max        = max(n_trees),
  					cv_deviance_mean   = mean(cv_deviance_mean),
  					cv_deviance_sd     = sd(cv_deviance_mean),
  					training_auc_mean  = mean(training_auc),
  					training_auc_sd    = sd(training_auc),
  					cv_auc_mean        = mean(cv_auc),
  					cv_auc_sd          = sd(cv_auc),
  					cv_correlation_mean = mean(cv_correlation),
  					cv_correlation_sd  = sd(cv_correlation),
  					deviance_explained_mean = mean(deviance_explained),
  					deviance_explained_sd   = sd(deviance_explained),
  					.groups = "drop"
  				)
  
  			cat("\n  Summary statistics:\n")
  			cat(sprintf("    CV AUC:             %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$cv_auc_mean, species_summary$cv_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Training AUC:       %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$training_auc_mean, species_summary$training_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Deviance explained: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%\n",
  			            species_summary$deviance_explained_mean, species_summary$deviance_explained_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Optimal trees:      %.0f ± %.0f (range: %d – %d)\n",
  			            species_summary$n_trees_mean, species_summary$n_trees_sd,
  			            species_summary$n_trees_min, species_summary$n_trees_max))
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE VARIABLE IMPORTANCE
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Aggregate importance across iterations (mean ± SD)
  			species_varimp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_varimp))
  
  			species_varimp_summary <- species_varimp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				summarise(
  					mean_influence = mean(rel_influence),
  					sd_influence   = sd(rel_influence),
  					min_influence  = min(rel_influence),
  					max_influence  = max(rel_influence),
  					.groups        = "drop"
  				) |>
  				arrange(desc(mean_influence)) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  			cat("\n  Top 5 variables:\n")
  			species_varimp_summary |>
  				slice_head(n = 5) |>
  				mutate(label = sprintf("    %s: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%", variable,
  				                       mean_influence, sd_influence)) |>
  				pull(label) |>
  				walk(cat, "\n")
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE AVERAGED PARTIAL DEPENDENCE PLOTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Average PDP curves across all iterations
  			## For each variable, bin x-values and compute mean ± SD of y
  			species_pdp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_pdp))
  
  			species_pdp_averaged <- species_pdp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				mutate(
  					## Create consistent x-bins within each variable's range
  					x_bin = cut(x, breaks = 50, labels = FALSE)
  				) |>
  				group_by(variable, x_bin) |>
  				summarise(
  					x_mean = mean(x),
  					y_mean = mean(y),
  					y_sd   = sd(y),
  					y_lower = y_mean - y_sd,
  					y_upper = y_mean + y_sd,
  					.groups = "drop"
  				) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# SAVE ALL OUTPUTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Clean species name for filenames
  			sp_clean <- str_replace_all(sp, " ", "_")
  
  			## Save model objects (list of 100 gbm.step objects)
  			saveRDS(
  				all_models,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_tuned_brt_models.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save per-iteration statistics
  			saveRDS(
  				species_stats,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_iteration_stats.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save summary statistics
  			saveRDS(
  				species_summary,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_summary_stats.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save variable importance (raw + summary)
  			saveRDS(
  				list(raw = species_varimp_raw, summary = species_varimp_summary),
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_variable_importance.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save averaged PDP data
  			saveRDS(
  				species_pdp_averaged,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_averaged_pdp.rds"))
  			)
  
  			cat("\n  Outputs saved to:", file.path(OUTPUT_DIR), "\n")
  
  			## Free memory before next species
  			rm(all_models, all_stats, all_varimp, all_pdp,
  			   species_stats, species_summary, species_varimp_raw,
  			   species_varimp_summary, species_pdp_raw, species_pdp_averaged)
  			gc()
  
  		}
  	) ## End species loop


  	## Load all individual species summaries and bind into a single table
    	summary_files <- list.files(
    		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),
    		pattern    = "_summary_stats\\.rds$",
    		full.names = TRUE
    	)
  
    	cross_species_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_files, readRDS) |>
    		arrange(desc(cv_auc_mean))
  
  	## Print formatted table
    	cross_species_summary |>
    		mutate(
    			label = sprintf(
    				"  %-25s  CV AUC: %.4f ± %.4f  |  DevExpl: %5.1f%% ± %4.1f%%  |  Trees: %5.0f ± %5.0f  |  Failed: %d",
    				species, cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_sd,
    				deviance_explained_mean, deviance_explained_sd,
    				n_trees_mean, n_trees_sd, n_failed
    			)
    		) |>
    		pull(label) |>
    		walk(cat, "\n")
  
  	## Save the combined summary
    	saveRDS(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "tuned_brt_cross_species_summary.rds")
    	)
    	write_csv(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "tuned_brt_cross_species_summary.csv")
    	)
```

```{r BRT Robust Species Pipeline}
  set.seed(1999)

  # CONFIGURATION
  
  	## Input directory: per-iteration .rds files with combined presence + PA data
  	  INPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_BRTs_New/PA_Iterations"
  
  	## Output directory for standard BRT results
  	  OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_BRTs_New/Standard_BRT_Results"
  
  	## Create output subdirectories
    	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models"),              showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence"),   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  	## Standard BRT parameters for the >100 occurrence tier
  	## tc=2: pairwise interactions (ecologically meaningful, estimable at n>100)
  	## bag.fraction=0.75: standard per Elith et al. (2008)
  	## n.folds=10: stable fold sizes with 118+ presences
  	## step.size=50: standard evaluation interval
    	BRT_PARAMS <- list(
    		tree.complexity = 2,
    		learning.rate   = 0.001,
    		bag.fraction    = 0.75,
    		n.folds         = 10,
    		family          = "bernoulli",
    		step.size       = 50,
    		max.trees       = 50000
    	)
  
  	## The six "Standard BRT" species (>100 occurrences)
    	STANDARD_SPECIES <- c(
    		"Culex pipiens",
    		"Ixodes ricinus",
    		"Aedes albopictus",
    		"Dermacentor marginatus",
    		"Dermacentor reticulatus",
    		"Aedes caspius"
    	)
  
  	## Species-to-taxon mapping (determines covariate set)
  	  MOSQUITO_SPECIES <- c("Culex pipiens", "Aedes albopictus", "Aedes caspius")
  	  TICK_SPECIES     <- c("Ixodes ricinus", "Dermacentor marginatus", "Dermacentor reticulatus")
  
  	## Categorical covariate
  	  CATEGORICAL_VAR <- "WorldCover"
  
  	## Mosquito covariates: climate + terrain + NDVI + wind (no soil)
    	MOSQUITO_VARS <- c(
    		"hurs", "pr", "sfcWind", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",
    		"NDVI", "Elevation", "Slope", CATEGORICAL_VAR
    	)
  
  	## Tick covariates: climate + terrain + NDVI + soil (no wind)
    	TICK_VARS <- c(
    		"hurs", "pr", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",
    		"NDVI", "Elevation", "Slope",
    		"BulkDensity", "CoarseFragments", "Nitrogen",
    		"SoilpH", "SandContent", "SiltContent", "SoilOrganicCarbon",
    		CATEGORICAL_VAR
    	)
  
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # HELPER FUNCTIONS
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  	#' Retrieve appropriate covariate names for a given species
    	get_predictor_vars <- function(species_name) {
    		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return(MOSQUITO_VARS)
    		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return(TICK_VARS)
    		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
    	}
  
  
  	#' Determine vector type label for a species
    	get_vector_type <- function(species_name) {
    		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return("mosquito")
    		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return("tick")
    		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
    	}
  
  
  	#' Prepare a data frame for BRT modeling
  	#' Selects response + predictors, drops NAs, converts WorldCover to factor
    	prepare_brt_data <- function(df, predictor_vars) {
    
    		model_df <- df |>
    			dplyr::select(presence, all_of(predictor_vars)) |>
    			drop_na()
    
    		## Ensure WorldCover is treated as categorical
    		if (CATEGORICAL_VAR %in% names(model_df)) {
    			model_df <- model_df |>
    				mutate(!!CATEGORICAL_VAR := as.factor(.data[[CATEGORICAL_VAR]]))
    		}
    
    		return(model_df)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Fit a single BRT model via dismo::gbm.step()
  	#' Returns NULL on failure rather than stopping the pipeline
  	  fit_single_brt <- function(model_data, predictor_vars, params) {
  
  		## Column indices required by gbm.step
  		  response_col   <- which(names(model_data) == "presence")
  		  predictor_cols <- which(names(model_data) %in% predictor_vars)
  
  		## Fit with suppressed convergence warnings (expected for binary data)
    		model <- tryCatch({
    			suppressWarnings({
    				gbm.step(
    					data            = as.data.frame(model_data),
    					gbm.x           = predictor_cols,
    					gbm.y           = response_col,
    					family           = params$family,
    					tree.complexity  = params$tree.complexity,
    					learning.rate    = params$learning.rate,
    					bag.fraction     = params$bag.fraction,
    					n.folds          = params$n.folds,
    					step.size        = params$step.size,
    					max.trees        = params$max.trees,
    					plot.main        = FALSE,
    					plot.folds       = FALSE,
    					silent           = TRUE
    				)
    			})
    		}, error = function(e) {
    			warning("BRT fitting failed: ", e$message)
    			return(NULL)
    		})
    
    		return(model)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Extract performance statistics from a fitted gbm.step model
    	extract_model_stats <- function(model) {
    
    		if (is.null(model)) {
    			return(tibble(
    				n_trees            = NA_integer_,
    				cv_deviance_mean   = NA_real_,
    				cv_deviance_se     = NA_real_,
    				training_auc       = NA_real_,
    				cv_auc             = NA_real_,
    				cv_correlation     = NA_real_,
    				deviance_explained = NA_real_
    			))
    		}
  
  		## Optimal number of trees from CV
  		  n_trees <- model$gbm.call$best.trees
  
  		## CV deviance at optimal tree number
  		  cv_deviance_mean <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean
  		  cv_deviance_se   <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.se
  
  		## AUC: training and cross-validated
  		  training_auc <- model$self.statistics$discrimination
  		  cv_auc       <- model$cv.statistics$discrimination.mean
  
  		## CV correlation (Pearson between observed and predicted in held-out folds)
  		  cv_correlation <- model$cv.statistics$correlation.mean
  
  		## Deviance explained: (null - residual) / null × 100
  		  deviance_explained <- (1 - (model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean /
  		                            model$self.statistics$mean.null)) * 100
  
    		tibble(
    			n_trees            = n_trees,
    			cv_deviance_mean   = cv_deviance_mean,
    			cv_deviance_se     = cv_deviance_se,
    			training_auc       = training_auc,
    			cv_auc             = cv_auc,
    			cv_correlation     = cv_correlation,
    			deviance_explained = deviance_explained
    		)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Extract variable importance from a fitted gbm.step model
  	  extract_var_importance <- function(model) {
  
  		  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## gbm.step stores relative influence in the summary
    		importance <- summary(model, plotit = FALSE) |>
    			as_tibble() |>
    			rename(variable = var, rel_influence = rel.inf)
    
    		return(importance)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Extract partial dependence data for all predictors from a gbm.step model
  	#' Returns a tibble with variable, x-value, and predicted y-value columns
  	  extract_partial_dependence <- function(model, predictor_vars) {
  
  		  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## Iterate across all predictors and extract PDP values
    		pdp_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
    			seq_along(predictor_vars),
    			function(var_idx) {
    
    				## gbm::plot.gbm returns the PDP data invisibly
      				pdp <- tryCatch({
      					plot.gbm(model, i.var = var_idx, return.grid = TRUE)
      				}, error = function(e) {
      					return(NULL)
      				})
    
    				if (is.null(pdp)) return(NULL)
    
    				tibble(
    					variable = predictor_vars[var_idx],
    					x        = as.numeric(pdp[[1]]),
    					y        = pdp$y
    				)
    			}
    		)
    
    		return(pdp_data)
    	}
  
  # LOAD AND VALIDATE ITERATION DATA
  	## List all iteration files
    	iteration_files <- list.files(
    		INPUT_DIR,
    		pattern    = "^brt_data_iteration_\\d{3}\\.rds$",
    		full.names = TRUE
    	) |>
    		sort()

    	if (length(iteration_files) != 100) {
    		warning("Expected 100 iteration files, found ", length(iteration_files))
    	}
  
  	## Inspect structure from first iteration
  	sample_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[1])
  	available_species <- unique(sample_data$species)
  	missing_species   <- setdiff(STANDARD_SPECIES, available_species)
  
  	if (length(missing_species) > 0) {
  		stop("Missing species in iteration data: ", paste(missing_species, collapse = ", "))
  	}
  
  	## Report per-species sample sizes from first iteration
    	sample_data |>
    		dplyr::filter(species %in% STANDARD_SPECIES) |>
    		group_by(species) |>
    		summarise(
    			n_presence = sum(presence == 1),
    			n_absence  = sum(presence == 0),
    			n_total    = n(),
    			.groups    = "drop"
    		) |>
    		arrange(desc(n_presence)) |>
    		mutate(label = sprintf("  %-25s %4d pres / %4d abs", species, n_presence, n_absence)) |>
    		pull(label) |>
    		walk(cat, "\n")
  
  	## Print parameter configuration
    	rm(sample_data)
    	gc()
  
  # RuN SOME MORE MODELS!
  	purrr::walk(
  		STANDARD_SPECIES,
  		function(sp) {
  
  			cat("\n───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  			cat("SPECIES:", sp, "\n")
  			cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  			## Determine covariate set based on taxon
  			  predictor_vars <- get_predictor_vars(sp)
  			  vector_type    <- get_vector_type(sp)
  
  			cat("  Vector type:", vector_type, "\n")
  			cat("  Predictors: ", length(predictor_vars), "\n")
  
  			## Pre-allocate result containers
    			all_models <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    			all_stats  <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    			all_varimp <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    			all_pdp    <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    
  			n_failed <- 0L
  
  			## Track timing for progress estimates
  			  t_start <- Sys.time()
  
    			purrr::walk(
    				seq_along(iteration_files),
    				function(i) {
    
    					## Progress reporting every 10 iterations + timing estimate
    					if (i %% 10 == 1 || i == length(iteration_files)) {
    						elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins"))
    						if (i > 1) {
    							rate <- elapsed / (i - 1)
    							remaining <- rate * (length(iteration_files) - i)
    							cat(sprintf("  Iteration %3d / %d  [%.1f min elapsed, ~%.1f min remaining]\n",
    							            i, length(iteration_files), elapsed, remaining))
    						} else {
    							cat(sprintf("  Iteration %3d / %d ...\n", i, length(iteration_files)))
    						}
    					}
  
  					## Load this iteration and filter to target species
  					  iter_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[i]) |>
  						  dplyr::filter(species == sp)
  
  					## Prepare for modeling
  					  model_data <- prepare_brt_data(iter_data, predictor_vars)
  
  					## Report sample size on first iteration
    					if (i == 1) {
    						n_pres <- sum(model_data$presence == 1)
    						n_abs  <- sum(model_data$presence == 0)
    						cat(sprintf("  Sample size: %d presences, %d pseudo-absences\n", n_pres, n_abs))
    					}
  
  					## Fit BRT
  					  model <- fit_single_brt(model_data, predictor_vars, BRT_PARAMS)
  
  					## Track failures
    					if (is.null(model)) {
    						n_failed <<- n_failed + 1L
    					}
  
  					## Store model object
  					all_models[[i]] <<- model
  
  					## Extract statistics
    					all_stats[[i]] <<- extract_model_stats(model) |>
    						mutate(iteration = i)
  
  					## Extract variable importance
    					varimp <- extract_var_importance(model)
    					if (!is.null(varimp)) {
    						all_varimp[[i]] <<- varimp |>
    							mutate(iteration = i)
    					}
  
  					## Extract partial dependence
    					pdp <- extract_partial_dependence(model, predictor_vars)
    					if (!is.null(pdp)) {
    						all_pdp[[i]] <<- pdp |>
    							mutate(iteration = i)
    					}
  
  					## Free memory
  					rm(iter_data, model_data, model)
  				}
  			) ## End iteration loop
  
  			## Report completion
    			total_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins"))
    			cat(sprintf("\n  Completed: %d models fit, %d failures (%.1f min total)\n",
    			            length(iteration_files) - n_failed, n_failed, total_time))
  
  
  			# COMPILE AND SAVE STATISTICS

    			## Per-iteration statistics
      			species_stats <- bind_rows(all_stats) |>
      				mutate(
      					species     = sp,
      					vector_type = vector_type,
      					.before     = everything()
      				)
  
  			## Summary across iterations
    			species_summary <- species_stats |>
    				dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_trees)) |>
    				summarise(
    					species                 = first(species),
    					vector_type             = first(vector_type),
    					n_models                = n(),
    					n_failed                = n_failed,
    					n_trees_mean            = mean(n_trees),
    					n_trees_sd              = sd(n_trees),
    					n_trees_min             = min(n_trees),
    					n_trees_max             = max(n_trees),
    					cv_deviance_mean        = mean(cv_deviance_mean),
    					cv_deviance_sd          = sd(cv_deviance_mean),
    					training_auc_mean       = mean(training_auc),
    					training_auc_sd         = sd(training_auc),
    					cv_auc_mean             = mean(cv_auc),
    					cv_auc_sd               = sd(cv_auc),
    					cv_correlation_mean     = mean(cv_correlation),
    					cv_correlation_sd       = sd(cv_correlation),
    					deviance_explained_mean = mean(deviance_explained),
    					deviance_explained_sd   = sd(deviance_explained),
    					.groups                 = "drop"
    				)
  
  			## Print summary
  			cat(sprintf("    CV AUC:             %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$cv_auc_mean, species_summary$cv_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Training AUC:       %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$training_auc_mean, species_summary$training_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Deviance explained: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%\n",
  			            species_summary$deviance_explained_mean, species_summary$deviance_explained_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Optimal trees:      %.0f ± %.0f (range: %d – %d)\n",
  			            species_summary$n_trees_mean, species_summary$n_trees_sd,
  			            species_summary$n_trees_min, species_summary$n_trees_max))
  
  			## Overfitting diagnostic: training-CV AUC gap
    			auc_gap <- species_summary$training_auc_mean - species_summary$cv_auc_mean
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE VARIABLE IMPORTANCE
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			species_varimp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_varimp))
  
  			species_varimp_summary <- species_varimp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				summarise(
  					mean_influence = mean(rel_influence),
  					sd_influence   = sd(rel_influence),
  					min_influence  = min(rel_influence),
  					max_influence  = max(rel_influence),
  					.groups        = "drop"
  				) |>
  				arrange(desc(mean_influence)) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  			cat("\n  Top 5 variables:\n")
  			species_varimp_summary |>
  				slice_head(n = 5) |>
  				mutate(label = sprintf("    %s: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%", variable,
  				                       mean_influence, sd_influence)) |>
  				pull(label) |>
  				walk(cat, "\n")
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE AVERAGED PARTIAL DEPENDENCE PLOTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			species_pdp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_pdp))
  
  			species_pdp_averaged <- species_pdp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				mutate(x_bin = cut(x, breaks = 50, labels = FALSE)) |>
  				group_by(variable, x_bin) |>
  				summarise(
  					x_mean  = mean(x),
  					y_mean  = mean(y),
  					y_sd    = sd(y),
  					y_lower = y_mean - y_sd,
  					y_upper = y_mean + y_sd,
  					.groups = "drop"
  				) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# SAVE ALL OUTPUTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			sp_clean <- str_replace_all(sp, " ", "_")
  
  			## Model objects (list of 100 gbm.step objects)
    			saveRDS(
    				all_models,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_standard_brt_models.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Per-iteration statistics
    			saveRDS(
    				species_stats,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_iteration_stats.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Summary statistics
    			saveRDS(
    				species_summary,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_summary_stats.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Variable importance (raw + summary)
    			saveRDS(
    				list(raw = species_varimp_raw, summary = species_varimp_summary),
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_variable_importance.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Averaged PDP data
    			saveRDS(
    				species_pdp_averaged,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_averaged_pdp.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Free memory
    			rm(all_models, all_stats, all_varimp, all_pdp,
    			   species_stats, species_summary, species_varimp_raw,
    			   species_varimp_summary, species_pdp_raw, species_pdp_averaged)
    			gc()
    		}
  	) ## End species loop
  
  # COMPILE CROSS-SPECIES SUMMARY TABLE

  	summary_files <- list.files(
  		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),
  		pattern    = "_summary_stats\\.rds$",
  		full.names = TRUE
  	)
  
  	cross_species_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_files, readRDS) |>
  		arrange(desc(cv_auc_mean))
  
  	## Formatted output with overfitting diagnostic
    	cross_species_summary |>
    		mutate(
    			auc_gap = training_auc_mean - cv_auc_mean,
    			flag    = if_else(auc_gap > 0.02, "⚠", "✓"),
    			label   = sprintf(
    				"  %-25s  CV AUC: %.4f ± %.4f  |  Gap: %.4f %s  |  DevExpl: %5.1f%%  |  Trees: %5.0f ± %4.0f",
    				species, cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_sd,
    				auc_gap, flag,
    				deviance_explained_mean,
    				n_trees_mean, n_trees_sd
    			)
    		) |>
    		pull(label) |>
    		walk(cat, "\n")
  
  	## Save combined summary
    	saveRDS(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "standard_brt_cross_species_summary.rds")
    	)
  
    	write_csv(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "standard_brt_cross_species_summary.csv")
    	)
```

```{r Baseline and Monthly Predictions — Tuned BRT + ESM Species}
  set.seed(1999)
  
  # CONFIGURATION

	## Output root — predictions saved here in Baseline/ and Monthly/ subfolders
    PREDICTION_DIR <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_Data/Predictions"

  	dir.create(file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly"),  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

	## Saved model locations
  	TUNED_BRT_MODEL_DIR <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_BRTs_New/Tuned_BRT_Results/models"
  	ESM_MODEL_DIR       <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks/Paper2_ESMs"

	## Species lists
  	TUNED_BRT_SPECIES <- c(
  		"Aedes vexans",

  	ESM_SPECIES <- c(

  		"Culex tritaeniorhynchus", "Culiseta annulata", "Culiseta longiareolata",
  		"Hyalomma aegyptium", "Rhipicephalus sanguineus"
  	)

	## Taxon-to-covariate mapping
  	TUNED_BRT_MOSQUITO <- c("Aedes vexans", "Culex theileri")
  	TUNED_BRT_TICK     <- c("Haemaphysalis inermis", "Hyalomma marginatum")
  	ESM_TICK           <- c("Hyalomma aegyptium", "Rhipicephalus sanguineus")

	## Covariate sets (must match layer names in raster stacks)

  		"hurs", "pr", "sfcWind", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",

  	TICK_COVARIATES <- c(

	## Clean month labels from the monthly_rasters list names

  	names(MONTH_LABELS) <- names(monthly_rasters)

	## Ordered month sequence for consistent output
  	MONTH_ORDER <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
  	                 "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")


# HELPER FUNCTIONS

	#' Get the correct covariate vector for a given species
  	get_covariates_for_species <- function(sp_name) {
  		if (sp_name %in% c(TUNED_BRT_MOSQUITO)) return(MOSQUITO_COVARIATES)
  		if (sp_name %in% c(TUNED_BRT_TICK))     return(TICK_COVARIATES)
  		if (sp_name %in% ESM_TICK)               return(TICK_COVARIATES)
  		## Default: ESM mosquitoes
  		return(MOSQUITO_COVARIATES)
  	}


	#' Prepare a raster for BRT prediction by subsetting layers and factoring WorldCover
  	prepare_raster_for_brt <- function(rast_stack, covariates) {
  
  		## Subset to the covariates this species needs
  		  proj_raster <- rast_stack[[covariates]]
  
  		## Ensure WorldCover is treated as a factor
    		if ("WorldCover" %in% names(proj_raster)) {
    			proj_raster[["WorldCover"]] <- as.factor(proj_raster[["WorldCover"]])
    		}
  
  		return(proj_raster)
  	}


	#' Generate mean + SD prediction from a list of 100 BRT models
	#' Returns a two-layer SpatRaster (mean, sd) on the probability scale
  	predict_brt_ensemble <- function(model_list, proj_raster) {
  
  		## Predict from each valid model
    		pred_stack <- model_list |>
    			compact() |>
    			map(function(mod) {
    				tryCatch({
    					terra::predict(
    						proj_raster,
    						mod,
    						n.trees = mod$gbm.call$best.trees,
    						type    = "response",
    						na.rm   = TRUE
    					)
    				}, error = function(e) {
    					warning("  Single BRT prediction failed: ", e$message)
    					return(NULL)
    				})
    			}) |>
    			compact() |>
    			rast()

  		## Pixel-wise mean and SD across the 100 models
  		  mean_rast <- app(pred_stack, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  		  sd_rast   <- app(pred_stack, sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
  
  		## Name the layers for consistency with existing output convention
  		  names(mean_rast) <- "mean"
  		  names(sd_rast)   <- "sd"
  
  		return(c(mean_rast, sd_rast))
  	}


	#' Run ecospat ESM projection + ensemble projection for one raster surface
	#' Returns a single-layer SpatRaster on the 0–1 probability scale
  	project_esm_to_raster <- function(esm_model, esm_ensemble, proj_raster) {
  
  		## Bivariate projections (one per predictor pair)
    		biv_proj <- ecospat.ESM.Projection(
    			ESM.modeling.output = esm_model,
    			new.env             = proj_raster,
    			parallel            = FALSE
    		)
  
  		## Weighted ensemble across bivariate models (0–1000 scale)
    		ens_proj <- ecospat.ESM.EnsembleProjection(
    			ESM.prediction.output       = biv_proj,
    			ESM.EnsembleModeling.output = esm_ensemble
    		)
  
  		## Rescale from 0–1000 to 0–1 probability
  		  ens_proj <- ens_proj / 1000
  
  		  names(ens_proj) <- "mean"
  
  		  return(ens_proj)
  	}


# PART 1: TUNED BRT PREDICTIONS (4 species × 100 models each)

  	purrr::walk(TUNED_BRT_SPECIES, function(sp) {
  
  		sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
  		covariates <- get_covariates_for_species(sp)
  		sp_start   <- Sys.time()
  
  		cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  		cat("SPECIES:", sp, "\n")
  		cat("  Covariates:", length(covariates), "\n")
  
  		## Load saved model objects (list of 100 gbm.step objects)
  		model_path <- file.path(
  			TUNED_BRT_MODEL_DIR,
  			paste0(sp_clean, "_tuned_brt_models.rds")
  		)
  
  		if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  			cat("  ⚠ Model file not found:", model_path, "\n")
  			cat("  Skipping this species.\n\n")
  			return(invisible())
  		}
  
  		models <- readRDS(model_path)
  		n_valid <- sum(!map_lgl(models, is.null))
  		cat("  Loaded", n_valid, "valid models out of", length(models), "\n")
  
  
  		## ── Baseline prediction ──────────────────────────────────────────
  		cat("  Predicting baseline...\n")
  
  		baseline_proj <- prepare_raster_for_brt(baseline_raster, covariates)
  		baseline_pred <- predict_brt_ensemble(models, baseline_proj)
  
  		writeRaster(
  			baseline_pred,
  			file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Baseline", paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif")),
  			overwrite = TRUE
  		)
  
  		cat("    ✓ Baseline saved (",
  		    round(minmax(baseline_pred[["mean"]])[2], 3), "max prob )\n")
  
  
  		## ── Monthly predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────
  		cat("  Predicting monthly surfaces...\n")
  
  		## Create species-specific monthly output folder
  		monthly_sp_dir <- file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly", sp_clean)
  		dir.create(monthly_sp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  		## Iterate across months in calendar order
  		purrr::walk(MONTH_ORDER, function(month_label) {
  
  			## Find the matching raster key in monthly_rasters
  			raster_key <- paste0("Georgia_Covariates_", month_label)
  
  			if (!raster_key %in% names(monthly_rasters)) {
  				cat("    ⚠ Missing raster for:", month_label, "\n")
  				return(invisible())
  			}
  
  			month_proj <- prepare_raster_for_brt(
  				monthly_rasters[[raster_key]], covariates
  			)
  			month_pred <- predict_brt_ensemble(models, month_proj)
  
  			writeRaster(
  				month_pred,
  				file.path(monthly_sp_dir, paste0(sp_clean, "_", month_label, ".tif")),
  				overwrite = TRUE
  			)
  
  			cat("    ✓", month_label, "\n")
  		})
  
  		## Free memory
  		rm(models, baseline_proj, baseline_pred)
  		gc()
  
  		elapsed <- round(difftime(Sys.time(), sp_start, units = "mins"), 1)
  		cat("  Done (", elapsed, "min )\n\n")
  	})


# PART 2: ESM PREDICTIONS (10 species)
  	
	purrr::walk(ESM_SPECIES, function(sp) {

		sp_clean <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
		sp_start <- Sys.time()

		## Load saved ESM model objects
		  model_path <- file.path(ESM_MODEL_DIR, sp_clean, "esm_model_objects.rds")

  		if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  			cat("  ⚠ Model file not found:", model_path, "\n")
  			cat("  Skipping this species.\n\n")
  			return(invisible())
  		}

  		esm_objs     <- readRDS(model_path)
  		esm_model    <- esm_objs$esm_model
  		esm_ensemble <- esm_objs$esm_ensemble
  		covariates   <- esm_objs$covariates

		## ── Baseline prediction ──────────────────────────────────────────

		## Subset baseline raster to the covariates the ESM was trained on
  		baseline_proj <- baseline_raster[[covariates]]

  		baseline_pred <- tryCatch({
  			project_esm_to_raster(esm_model, esm_ensemble, baseline_proj)
  		}, error = function(e) {
  			cat("    ✗ Baseline projection failed:", e$message, "\n")
  			return(NULL)
  		})

  		if (!is.null(baseline_pred)) {
  			writeRaster(
  				baseline_pred,
  				file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Baseline", paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif")),
  				overwrite = TRUE
  			)
  			cat("    ✓ Baseline saved (",
  			    round(minmax(baseline_pred)[2], 3), "max prob )\n")
  		}


		## ── Monthly predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────
  		monthly_sp_dir <- file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly", sp_clean)
  		dir.create(monthly_sp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  		purrr::walk(MONTH_ORDER, function(month_label) {
  
  			raster_key <- paste0("Georgia_Covariates_", month_label)
  
  			if (!raster_key %in% names(monthly_rasters)) {
  				cat("    ⚠ Missing raster for:", month_label, "\n")
  				return(invisible())
  			}

			## Subset monthly raster to ESM covariates
			  month_proj <- monthly_rasters[[raster_key]][[covariates]]

  			month_pred <- tryCatch({
  				project_esm_to_raster(esm_model, esm_ensemble, month_proj)
  			}, error = function(e) {
  				cat("    ✗", month_label, "projection failed:", e$message, "\n")
  				return(NULL)
  			})

  			if (!is.null(month_pred)) {
  				writeRaster(
  					month_pred,
  					file.path(monthly_sp_dir,
  					          paste0(sp_clean, "_", month_label, ".tif")),
  					overwrite = TRUE
  				)
  				cat("    ✓", month_label, "\n")
  			}
  		})

		## Free memory
  		rm(esm_objs, esm_model, esm_ensemble, baseline_proj, baseline_pred)
  		gc()

  		elapsed <- round(difftime(Sys.time(), sp_start, units = "mins"), 1)
  		cat("  Done (", elapsed, "min )\n\n")
  	})


# SUMMARY

	## Count output files
  	n_baseline <- length(list.files(
  		file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Baseline"),
  		pattern = "\\.tif$"
  	))
  	n_monthly <- length(list.files(
  		file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly"),
  		pattern = "\\.tif$",
  		recursive = TRUE
  	))
```

```{r Model Evaluation and Landscape Summaries}
# HELPER FUNCTIONS

	#' Extract per-iteration evaluation metrics from a single gbm.step model
	#' Returns CV AUC, training AUC, deviance explained, TSS, and n_presences
  	extract_brt_metrics <- function(model) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) {
  			return(tibble(
  				cv_auc             = NA_real_,
  				training_auc       = NA_real_,
  				deviance_explained = NA_real_,
  				tss                = NA_real_,
  				n_presences        = NA_integer_
  			))
  		}

		## Training predictions and observed response
		  preds <- model$fitted
		  obs   <- model$gbm.call$dataframe[[model$gbm.call$gbm.y]]

		## dismo evaluation object for TSS computation
  		eval_obj <- tryCatch(
  			dismo::evaluate(p = preds[obs == 1], a = preds[obs == 0]),
  			error = function(e) NULL
  		)

		## TSS = max(sensitivity + specificity - 1) across all thresholds
  		tss_val <- if (!is.null(eval_obj)) {
  			max(eval_obj@TPR + eval_obj@TNR - 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  		} else NA_real_

		## gbm.step internal performance metrics
  		cv_auc  <- model$cv.statistics$discrimination.mean
  		tr_auc  <- model$self.statistics$discrimination
  		dev_exp <- (1 - (model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean /
  		                 model$self.statistics$mean.null)) * 100
  
  		tibble(
  			cv_auc             = cv_auc,
  			training_auc       = tr_auc,
  			deviance_explained = dev_exp,
  			tss                = tss_val,
  			n_presences        = as.integer(sum(obs == 1))
  		)
  	}


	#' Process all 100 BRT models for one species: extract per-iteration
	#' metrics and return summary statistics (mean ± SD)
	#' Boyce index is computed separately from ensemble rasters (see below)
  	summarise_brt_species <- function(sp_name, model_list, tier) {
  
  		cat("  Extracting metrics from", sum(!map_lgl(model_list, is.null)),
  		    "models...\n")
  
  		## Extract metrics from each iteration
    		iter_metrics <- model_list |>
    			map_dfr(extract_brt_metrics)
  
  		## Summarise across iterations
  		tibble(
  			species                 = sp_name,
  			modeling_tier           = tier,
  			n_occurrences           = iter_metrics$n_presences[1],
  			cv_auc_mean             = mean(iter_metrics$cv_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			cv_auc_sd               = sd(iter_metrics$cv_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			training_auc_mean       = mean(iter_metrics$training_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			training_auc_sd         = sd(iter_metrics$training_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			deviance_explained_mean = mean(iter_metrics$deviance_explained, na.rm = TRUE),
  			deviance_explained_sd   = sd(iter_metrics$deviance_explained, na.rm = TRUE),
  			tss_mean                = mean(iter_metrics$tss, na.rm = TRUE),
  			tss_sd                  = sd(iter_metrics$tss, na.rm = TRUE),
  			boyce_mean              = NA_real_,
  			boyce_sd                = NA_real_
  		)
  	}


	#' Compute Boyce index for a BRT species using the ensemble mean raster
	#' and occurrence coordinates extracted from the master PA dataset
	#' Returns a single Boyce correlation value (Spearman cor of P/E ratio)
  	compute_brt_boyce <- function(sp_name, pres_coords_sf, baseline_dir) {
  
  		sp_clean <- gsub(" ", "_", sp_name)
  
  		## Load baseline ensemble mean raster
  		baseline_path <- file.path(baseline_dir, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))
  		if (!file.exists(baseline_path)) {
  			cat("    ⚠ Baseline raster not found\n")
  			return(NA_real_)
  		}
  
  		pred_rast <- rast(baseline_path)
  		mean_rast <- if (nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast
  
  		## Full landscape predicted values (background distribution)
  		fit_vals <- values(mean_rast, na.rm = TRUE) |> as.numeric()
  
  		## Convert presence coords to SpatVector for extraction
  		pres_vect <- vect(pres_coords_sf)
  
  		## Extract ensemble predictions at known occurrence locations
  		obs_vals <- terra::extract(mean_rast, pres_vect)[[2]] |>
  			na.omit() |>
  			as.numeric()
  
  		if (length(obs_vals) < 5) {
  			cat("    ⚠ Too few valid presence extractions for Boyce\n")
  			return(NA_real_)
  		}
  
  		## Boyce index (predicted-to-expected ratio correlation)
  		boyce_result <- tryCatch(
  			ecospat::ecospat.boyce(
  				fit     = fit_vals,
  				obs     = obs_vals,
  				PEplot  = FALSE
  			),
  			error = function(e) {
  				cat("    ⚠ Boyce computation failed:", e$message, "\n")
  				NULL
  			}
  		)
  
  		if (!is.null(boyce_result)) boyce_result$cor else NA_real_
  	}


	#' Extract evaluation metrics from a saved ESM model object
	#' ESMs store AUC, TSS, and Boyce in the ensemble evaluation output
  	summarise_esm_species <- function(sp_name, esm_objs) {
  
  		esm_ensemble <- esm_objs$esm_ensemble
  
  		## Evaluation metrics from ecospat ensemble
  		evals <- esm_ensemble$ESM.evaluations
  
  		auc_vals   <- evals$AUC
  		tss_vals   <- evals$TSS
  		boyce_vals <- evals$Boyce
  
  		## Attempt to extract n_occurrences from ESM model objects
  		## The BIOMOD formatted data stores presence count; exact accessor
  		## depends on your ESM object structure — adjust as needed
  		n_occ <- tryCatch({
  			if (!is.null(esm_objs$n_presences)) {
  				as.integer(esm_objs$n_presences)
  			} else if (!is.null(esm_objs$biomod_data)) {
  				## biomod2 formatted data stores coords for presences
  				sum(esm_objs$biomod_data@data.species == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  			} else {
  				NA_integer_
  			}
  		}, error = function(e) NA_integer_)
  
  		tibble(
  			species                 = sp_name,
  			modeling_tier           = "ESM",
  			n_occurrences           = n_occ,
  			cv_auc_mean             = mean(auc_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			cv_auc_sd               = sd(auc_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			training_auc_mean       = NA_real_,
  			training_auc_sd         = NA_real_,
  			deviance_explained_mean = NA_real_,
  			deviance_explained_sd   = NA_real_,
  			tss_mean                = mean(tss_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			tss_sd                  = sd(tss_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			boyce_mean              = mean(boyce_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			boyce_sd                = sd(boyce_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  		)
  	}


# PART 1: EXTRACT EVALUATION METRICS
```

```{r maxSSS Thresholds and Landscape Proportion}
  set.seed(1999)

  # CONFIGURATION

    ## Paths (consistent with prior chunks)
      ONEDRIVE     <- "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/OneDrive - University of Florida/General - Georgia Ticks/Georgia_Ticks"
      BASELINE_DIR <- file.path(ONEDRIVE, "Paper2_Data/Predictions/Baseline")
      OUTPUT_DIR   <- file.path(ONEDRIVE, "Paper2_Data/Summaries")
      dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    ## Model directories
      STANDARD_BRT_MODEL_DIR <- file.path(ONEDRIVE, "Paper2_Data/Predictions/Models")
      TUNED_BRT_MODEL_DIR    <- file.path(ONEDRIVE, "Paper2_BRTs_New/Tuned_BRT_Results/models")
      ESM_MODEL_DIR          <- file.path(ONEDRIVE, "Paper2_ESMs")

    ## Species by tier
      STANDARD_BRT_SPECIES <- c(
        "Culex pipiens", "Ixodes ricinus", "Aedes albopictus",
        "Dermacentor marginatus", "Dermacentor reticulatus", "Aedes caspius"
      )

      TUNED_BRT_SPECIES <- c(
        "Aedes vexans", "Culex theileri",
        "Haemaphysalis inermis", "Hyalomma marginatum"
      )

      ESM_SPECIES <- c(
        "Aedes aegypti", "Aedes geniculatus",
        "Anopheles maculipennis", "Anopheles plumbeus", "Anopheles sacharovi",
        "Culex tritaeniorhynchus", "Culiseta annulata", "Culiseta longiareolata",
        "Hyalomma aegyptium", "Rhipicephalus sanguineus"
      )


  # maxSSS COMPUTATION

    #' Compute the maxSSS threshold from a vector of predictions and binary observed values
    #' Evaluates candidate thresholds and returns the value maximising sensitivity + specificity
      compute_maxsss <- function(preds, obs) {

        pres_p <- preds[obs == 1]
        abs_p  <- preds[obs == 0]

        ## Generate candidate thresholds from the unique predicted values
          cands <- sort(unique(preds[!is.na(preds)]))

        ## Downsample candidates if the set is very large (speed optimisation)
          if (length(cands) > 500) {
            cands <- quantile(cands, seq(0, 1, length.out = 500), na.rm = TRUE)
          }

        ## Evaluate sensitivity + specificity at each candidate
          ss <- purrr::map_dbl(cands, function(t) {
            sum(pres_p >= t) / length(pres_p) + sum(abs_p < t) / length(abs_p)
          })

        cands[which.max(ss)]
      }


    #' Extract maxSSS from a single fitted gbm.step model object
    #' Uses the training fitted values and observed response stored in the model
      extract_brt_maxsss <- function(model) {

        if (is.null(model)) return(NA_real_)

        ## Recover fitted predictions and observed binary response
          preds <- model$fitted
          obs   <- model$gbm.call$dataframe[[model$gbm.call$gbm.y]]

        compute_maxsss(preds, obs)
      }


  # PART 1: BRT THRESHOLDS (Standard + Tuned)
  ## For each species, load the 100 saved model objects, compute maxSSS per
  ## iteration, and summarise as mean ± SD across the ensemble

    brt_threshold_specs <- bind_rows(
      tibble(
        species    = STANDARD_BRT_SPECIES,
        tier       = "Standard_BRT",
        model_dir  = STANDARD_BRT_MODEL_DIR,
        file_suffix = "_models.rds"
      ),
      tibble(
        species    = TUNED_BRT_SPECIES,
        tier       = "Tuned_BRT",
        model_dir  = TUNED_BRT_MODEL_DIR,
        file_suffix = "_tuned_brt_models.rds"
      )
    )

    brt_thresholds <- purrr::pmap_dfr(brt_threshold_specs, function(species, tier, model_dir, file_suffix) {

      sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
      model_path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(sp_clean, file_suffix))

      cat(species, "(", tier, ") ...")

      if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
        cat(" ⚠ model file not found\n")
        return(tibble(
          species       = species,
          modeling_tier = tier,
          maxsss_mean   = NA_real_,
          maxsss_sd     = NA_real_,
          n_models      = NA_integer_
        ))
      }

      ## Load the list of 100 gbm.step model objects
        models <- readRDS(model_path)

      ## Compute maxSSS from each valid iteration
        iter_thresholds <- purrr::map_dbl(models, extract_brt_maxsss)

      ## Remove NAs from failed iterations
        valid_thresholds <- iter_thresholds[!is.na(iter_thresholds)]

      cat(" ", length(valid_thresholds), "valid |",
          "maxSSS:", round(mean(valid_thresholds), 4), "±",
          round(sd(valid_thresholds), 4), "\n")

      rm(models); gc()

      tibble(
        species       = species,
        modeling_tier = tier,
        maxsss_mean   = mean(valid_thresholds),
        maxsss_sd     = sd(valid_thresholds),
        n_models      = length(valid_thresholds)
      )
    })


  # PART 2: ESM THRESHOLDS
  ## These were already computed and saved during the ESM fitting pipeline;
  ## retrieve them from the stored model objects

    esm_thresholds <- purrr::map_dfr(ESM_SPECIES, function(sp) {

      sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
      model_path <- file.path(ESM_MODEL_DIR, sp_clean, "esm_model_objects.rds")

      cat(sp, "(ESM) ...")

      if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
        cat(" ⚠ model file not found\n")
        return(tibble(
          species       = sp,
          modeling_tier = "ESM",
          maxsss_mean   = NA_real_,
          maxsss_sd     = NA_real_,
          n_models      = NA_integer_
        ))
      }

      esm_objs <- readRDS(model_path)

      ## ESM pipeline saved a single maxSSS value (no per-iteration SD available)
        maxsss_val <- esm_objs$thresholds$maxsss

      cat(" maxSSS:", round(maxsss_val, 4), "\n")

      tibble(
        species       = sp,
        modeling_tier = "ESM",
        maxsss_mean   = maxsss_val,
        maxsss_sd     = NA_real_,
        n_models      = 1L
      )
    })


  # COMBINE ALL THRESHOLDS

    all_thresholds <- bind_rows(brt_thresholds, esm_thresholds) |>
      arrange(modeling_tier, species)

    cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    cat("  maxSSS THRESHOLDS — ALL SPECIES\n")
    cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print(all_thresholds, n = 20, width = Inf)


  # PART 3: BINARY CLASSIFICATION + LANDSCAPE PROPORTION
  ## Apply each species' mean maxSSS threshold to the baseline prediction raster
  ## to classify every pixel as present (≥ threshold) or absent (< threshold),
  ## then compute the proportion of the landscape classified as present

    landscape_proportion <- purrr::pmap_dfr(all_thresholds, function(species, modeling_tier,
                                                                       maxsss_mean, maxsss_sd,
                                                                       n_models) {

      sp_clean      <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
      baseline_path <- file.path(BASELINE_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))

      cat("  ", species, "...")

      if (is.na(maxsss_mean) || !file.exists(baseline_path)) {
        cat(" ⚠ skipped (missing threshold or raster)\n")
        return(tibble(
          species            = species,
          modeling_tier      = modeling_tier,
          maxsss_threshold   = maxsss_mean,
          n_pixels_total     = NA_integer_,
          n_pixels_present   = NA_integer_,
          pct_landscape      = NA_real_
        ))
      }

      ## Load baseline raster (BRT = 2-layer [mean, sd]; ESM = 1-layer)
        pred_rast <- rast(baseline_path)
        mean_rast <- if (nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast

      ## Binary classification: 1 if predicted probability ≥ threshold, else 0
        binary_rast <- mean_rast >= maxsss_mean

      ## Extract pixel counts (non-NA cells only)
        all_vals     <- values(binary_rast, na.rm = TRUE)
        n_total      <- length(all_vals)
        n_present    <- sum(all_vals == 1)
        pct_present  <- (n_present / n_total) * 100

      cat(" ", round(pct_present, 2), "% present\n")

      tibble(
        species            = species,
        modeling_tier      = modeling_tier,
        maxsss_threshold   = round(maxsss_mean, 4),
        n_pixels_total     = as.integer(n_total),
        n_pixels_present   = as.integer(n_present),
        pct_landscape      = round(pct_present, 2)
      )
    })


  # RESULTS

    cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    cat("  LANDSCAPE PROPORTION AT maxSSS — ALL SPECIES\n")
    cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print(landscape_proportion, n = 20, width = Inf)


  # OPTIONAL: SAVE BINARY RASTERS
  ## Writes a classified present/absent .tif for each species alongside the
  ## continuous baseline predictions

    BINARY_DIR <- file.path(ONEDRIVE, "Paper2_Data/Predictions/Binary_maxSSS")
    dir.create(BINARY_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    purrr::pwalk(
      landscape_proportion |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(maxsss_threshold)),
      function(species, modeling_tier, maxsss_threshold, ...) {

        sp_clean      <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
        baseline_path <- file.path(BASELINE_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))

        pred_rast   <- rast(baseline_path)
        mean_rast   <- if (nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast
        binary_rast <- mean_rast >= maxsss_threshold

        names(binary_rast) <- "present"

        writeRaster(
          binary_rast,
          file.path(BINARY_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_binary_maxsss.tif")),
          overwrite = TRUE,
          datatype  = "INT1U"
        )
      }
    )

    cat("\nBinary rasters saved to:\n ", BINARY_DIR, "\n")


  # SAVE SUMMARY TABLES

    ## Thresholds table
      write_csv(
        all_thresholds,
        file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "maxsss_thresholds_all_species.csv")
      )

    ## Landscape proportion table
      write_csv(
        landscape_proportion,
        file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "landscape_proportion_at_maxsss.csv")
      )

    ## Combined table (merge thresholds with landscape stats)
      combined_summary <- all_thresholds |>
        left_join(
          landscape_proportion |> dplyr::select(species, n_pixels_total, n_pixels_present, pct_landscape),
          by = "species"
        )

      write_csv(
        combined_summary,
        file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "maxsss_threshold_and_landscape_summary.csv")
      )

    cat("\nSummary tables saved to:\n ", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
```
